title: Add checkpointed RAG authoring CLI and compact example suite
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Introduce a checkpointed authoring CLI that lets developers snapshot RAG sessions, resume from checkpoints, and run compact example suites that exercise incremental indexing and telemetry probes. No breaking changes.
body:
Motivation: Authors and integrators building retrieval-augmented agents often need repeatable, inspectable authoring loops with lightweight checkpoints so they can reproduce regressions and iterate on retrieval/LLM prompt variants. This PR adds a minimal, developer-first CLI that captures stepwise checkpoints, emits compact telemetry probes for token-level timing and kernel selection traces (sanitized), and ships a focused example suite that demonstrates incremental indexing and resume semantics. The goal is a low-friction onboarding artifact for new teams to validate RAG workflows against local indexes and to run reproducible smoke-evals.

What this PR contains: - quickstarts/rag-checkpoint-cli/README.md: an end-to-end developer guide with recipes. - cli/rag-checkpoint.ts: the CLI entrypoint implementing checkpoint, resume, replay, and compact-report subcommands. - examples/checkpointed-suite/: three small scenario manifests (faq-bot, ticket-assistant, policy-retriever) and seeded sample corpora. - telemetry/probes-config.yaml: predefined probe knobs used in examples (sampling, redact-level). - docs/snippets/rag-checkpoint-usage.md: concise usage snippets referenced by docsite. - tests/cli-smoke.spec.ts: light E2E smoke tests for resume semantics.

Design notes: - Checkpoints are JSONL records (metadata + KV-cache fingerprints) designed to be small and portable; sensitive fields are redacted by default. - Resume semantics prioritize deterministic document order and stable index ids; CLI supports an --allow-stale flag for quick iteration. - Telemetry probes are intentionally compact (per-step summaries) to avoid PII and to make local inspections easy.

Usage example (short): node ./cli/rag-checkpoint.ts checkpoint --scenario faq-bot --index ./examples/checkpointed-suite/faq-index --out ./runs/run-2026-02-18.jsonl  
node ./cli/rag-checkpoint.ts resume --run ./runs/run-2026-02-18.jsonl --replay-mode deterministic

Checklist: - [x] Add CLI implementation and tests - [x] Add README and developer recipes - [x] Add telemetry probe configuration and doc snippets - [x] Basic smoke E2E tests passing locally - [x] Docs references wired to quickstarts section

Testing and CI: Local unit and smoke tests run via yarn test. The PR triggered CI where unit-tests passed, one integration case (indexer-compat) initially failed on CI due to timing; I adjusted the test harness to mock a slower embedder and re-ran. Final CI green.

Rollout and migration: This is additive; examples and CLI live under quickstarts. No runtime or API surface changes to hosted or dedicated services. Recommend linking this quickstart from the RAG authoring guide and the telemetry playbook.

Related: Links: - Quickstart page (docs): https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstarts/rag-checkpoint-cli - Linear: ENG-1419 - Support ticket: SUP-4217

If reviewers are happy I'll squash-merge and add a short docsite redirect for the new quickstart.

review_comments: Diego Martinez: Nice focused quickstart — two asks: (1) add an explicit example of how kv_fingerprint is computed so integrators understand cache invalidation conditions; (2) can we default the telemetry sampling to 1% in CI tests to minimize flakiness?

Asha Patel (author): Added a short appendix to README explaining kv_fingerprint derivation (index id + trunc SHA of top-k doc ids) and switched the CI test harness to sample=0.01 for CI runs. See commit c1d2e3f.

Riley Chen: Tests look good; one nit about CLI UX: make resume --replay-mode accept 'deterministic'|'best-effort' and document differences. Also please add a short note about not using checkpoints for unredacted PII in README.
Asha Patel: Addressed both: updated CLI flag parsing and README warnings. Added explicit example to docs/snippets/rag-checkpoint-usage.md.
Miriam Novak: Approving — ran the examples locally and verified resume produced identical top-3 doc ids with deterministic mode. CI green after rerun.

notes: Follow-up: wire quickstart into docs sidebar (DOC-88).
Consider adding a small Go example wrapper in a follow-up PR to show cross-language replay clients.
Telemetry probe outputs are intentionally compact; teams wanting full token traces should request expanded probes behind an opt-in flag in a future PR.
